hotel.name: Palacio del Inka, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Cusco

verified_facts.text: The hotel is housed within a 500-year-old mansion in the heart of Cusco.
verified_facts.excerpt: is housed within a 500-year-old mansion in the heart of Cusco, Peru

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located across from Qoricancha, the Temple of the Sun.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located across from Qoricancha, the Temple of the Sun, and minutes from shops and museums

verified_facts.text: There are 195 pieces of artwork from the pre-Inca, Inca, colonial and republican periods on display, 60 of them original paintings from the Escuela Cusquena.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are 195 pieces of artwork from the pre Inca, Inca, colonial and republican period on display, of which 60 are original paintings from the Escuela Cusqueña.

verified_facts.text: On the main facade, Salas y Valdes carved four busts on the lintel of the portal, giving the house its name, the Casa de los Cuatro Bustos.
verified_facts.excerpt: Salas y Valdés carved four busts on the lintel of the portal

verified_facts.text: The hotel's 8-angled stone, the heart of the Incan-style wall, is made of green diorite rather than granite.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is the only piece of the wall that is not of granite, but of green diorite

verified_facts.text: The lobby's sky-blue color is a tribute to the Andahuaylillas church, known as the Sistine Chapel of the Americas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its sky-blue color is a tribute to the Andahuaylillas church, known as the Sistine Chapel of Americas

verified_facts.text: The property is part of the area UNESCO designated as Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
verified_facts.excerpt: in 1983 it was included in the central area designated by UNESCO as Cultural Heritage of Humanity

verified_facts.text: Rooms have vaulted ceilings hand painted by local artists with colorful floral motifs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admire your room's vaulted ceilings, hand painted by local artists using colorful floral motifs

verified_facts.text: Guests can lounge on a private balcony with views of downtown Cusco or the distant Andes mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lounge on your private balcony for stunning views of downtown Cusco or the distant Andes mountains.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms feature aged cream travertine marble and gilded light fixtures.
verified_facts.excerpt: a bathroom with aged cream Travertine marble and gilded light fixtures

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Le Chemin bath amenities by BYREDO, created for the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: luxurious Le Chemin bath amenities by BYREDO, created for our hotel

verified_facts.text: The Andes Spirit Spa's thermal circuit offers a dry sauna, Turkish bath, Spanish showers with lighting effects and a Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience our Thermal Circuit, providing Dry Sauna, Turkish Bath, Spanish showers with lighting effects and a Jacuzzi.

verified_facts.text: Andes Spirit Spa treatments use Germaine de Capuccini products and combine ancient and modern techniques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Performed with premier Germaine de Capuccini amenities, combining ancient and modern techniques

verified_facts.text: The spa has single therapy rooms and two couple's massage rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Single therapy rooms and two couple's massage rooms

verified_facts.text: Guests can meet baby alpacas at the hotel as part of an experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet the Baby Alpaca Inside Our Facilities As Part of a Unique Experience

verified_facts.text: A weekly art tour takes guests through the hotel's 195 art pieces and 60 original Escuela Cusquena paintings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in our history through 195 art pieces and treasures that are part of the hotel and 60 original paintings of the Escuela Cusqueña.

verified_facts.text: Inti Raymi restaurant serves traditional Peruvian cuisine made with local Andean ingredients, in the lounge or the Cuatro Bustos outdoor patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers traditional Peruvian cuisine made with local ingredients from the Andes. From breakfast to dinner, you can taste exquisite dishes in the lounge or the "Cuatro Bustos" outdoor patio.

verified_facts.text: Rumi Bar is set beside original Inca walls from the ancient Qoricancha temple.
verified_facts.excerpt: while admiring original XIII-century Inca walls from the ancient Qoricancha temple

verified_facts.text: The breakfast buffet is accompanied by a live harp player.
verified_facts.excerpt: Served daily and accompanied by a live harp player

verified_facts.text: The Mantay Gallery shows contemporary creative work as part of the hotel's Route of Art.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mantay Gallery completes the enriching artistic journey for guests.

verified_facts.text: The concierge is Les Clefs d'Or certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: Les Clefs d’Or–certified Luxury Collection Concierge

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Palacio del Inka, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Cusco does not offer on-site parking.

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Palacio del Inka, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Cusco do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: Imperial suites offer street or Kusicancha courtyard views, with a private balcony in select suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Imperial Suite offers characteristic street or Kusicancha courtyard views from a private balcony in select suites

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a Pisco Sour masterclass with the hotel's bartenders.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our bartenders have prepared a hands-on experience where you will learn how to prepare the perfect Pisco sour.

subjective.text: The Andes Spirit Spa calls itself the most complete spa in the city.
